user.title: Email delivery
user.description: HomeKit Intercom sends an email that your Siri Shortcut picks up and announces on your HomePods. Choose the notify action that sends email (e.g. your Google Mail account) and the address the Shortcut watches.

data_description.notify_service: The name after `notify.`, for example `you_gmail_com` from the Google Mail integration.
data_description.recipient: The mailbox on the iPhone, iPad or Mac that runs your Shortcut automation.

zone.title: First zone
zone.description: A zone is a group of HomePods and the subject prefix your Shortcut looks for. You can add more zones later.

data_description.prefix: Without the colon, e.g. `HA Announce All` sends `HA Announce All: The washing machine has finished.`.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional. Non-urgent messages wait until this shows someone is there (`on`, `home`, or a zone count above 0). Unavailable counts as occupied.

error.service_not_found: That notify action does not exist.

user.title: Add zone
user.description: Match the prefix to the one your Siri Shortcut looks for.

data_description.prefix: Without the colon, e.g. `HA Announce Kitchen`.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional. Non-urgent messages wait until this shows someone is there (`on`, `home`, or a zone count above 0). Unavailable counts as occupied.

data_description.prefix: Without the colon, e.g. `HA Announce Kitchen`.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional. Non-urgent messages wait until this shows someone is there (`on`, `home`, or a zone count above 0). Unavailable counts as occupied.

error.empty: Name and prefix cannot be empty.
error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.

data_description.batch_window: Wait this long after the latest message for more to arrive before sending them together.
data_description.max_wait: Send regardless once the first queued message has waited this long.
data_description.max_length: Longer combined announcements are split across several emails.
data_description.quiet_mode: Urgent messages and those set to ignore quiet hours are always sent.

error.service_not_found: That notify action does not exist.

no_zones_targeted.message: Target at least one HomeKit Intercom zone (notify entity).

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Queue a message to be announced on a zone's HomePods. Messages arriving close together are combined into one announcement.

message.name: Message
message.description: What to announce. Templates are supported.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent messages are sent immediately (along with anything queued), ignoring quiet hours and presence.

key.name: Key
key.description: Identifies this notification. A newer message with the same key replaces a queued one and is used for cooldown.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Ignore this message if the same key was announced within this time. Requires a key.

quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Whether this message waits for quiet hours to end.

stale_after.name: Stale after
stale_after.description: Discard this message if it is still waiting (for presence or quiet hours) after this long. Leave empty to wait indefinitely.

flush.name: Send now
flush.description: Immediately send any queued messages for the targeted zones.
